CustomField.label: Pull Frequency
CustomField.description: How often the scheduled job pulls updates from Veleiro (no webhook yet). Values: off | hourly | daily. Blank defaults to off. Set it from the Veleiro Mappings panel.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: off, hourly, or daily. How often Salesforce pulls fresh data from Veleiro. Best set from the Veleiro Mappings panel.
